title: Robust Gradient Clipping
tagline: Compare four clipping strategies for stabilizing optimizer updates under heavy-tailed gradients.

curves.label: Hard Percentile Clip
curves.code: function hardPercentileClip(g, p){ const mags=g.map(x=>Math.abs(x)); const q=mags.sort((a,b)=>a-b)[Math.floor(p*mags.length)]; return g.map(x=>Math.max(-q, Math.min(q, x))); }
curves.name: Hard Percentile Clip

curves.label: Global Norm Clip
curves.code: function globalNormClip(vec, C){ const norm=Math.sqrt(vec.reduce((a,x)=>a+x*x,0)); const scale = norm > C ? C/(norm+1e-9) : 1; return vec.map(x=>x*scale); }
curves.name: Global Norm Clip

curves.label: Adaptive EMA Clip
curves.code:
function emaAdaptiveClip(vec, C0, beta){ let C=C0; // updated externally via C=beta*C+(1-beta)*measuredNorm
 const norm=Math.sqrt(vec.reduce((a,x)=>a+x*x,0)); const scale = norm > C ? C/(norm+1e-9) : 1; return vec.map(x=>x*scale); }
curves.name: Adaptive EMA Clip

curves.label: Layerwise Norm Clip
curves.code: function layerwiseClip(layers, Cs){ return layers.map((layer,i)=>{ const norm=Math.sqrt(layer.reduce((a,x)=>a+x*x,0)); const scale = norm > Cs[i] ? Cs[i]/(norm+1e-9) : 1; return layer.map(x=>x*scale); }); }
curves.name: Layerwise Norm Clip
